historical_artifacts.note: Unpackaged TWB companion produced by the same builder as the primary TWBX.

notes: Rebuilt with cwtwb 0.27.1 (pin d0c26cf) from the packaged Hyper extract using public SDK APIs only; the author workbook was never opened by the builder.
The bar chart addresses its INDEX()/window table calcs by Year and pins the 2023 duration with a custom-labelled field-backed reference line.
The Index pill is bound as an ordinal (not quantitative) instance, matching the author: a quantitative Index turns Columns into a continuous axis and renders the bars as thin strips.

Cloud honours the author's teal #52b7d8 / orange #e16032 boolean palette after the cwtwb fix that carries the worksheet table-calc context onto the datasource palette column-instance (a table-calc-derived colour field was otherwise rendered with the default categorical palette).
The Latest Duration table calc addresses the specific dimensions [Decade],[Year] (matching the author), so the "2:38 in 2023" line resolves to the global 2023 value (158) in every decade pane.

The author's 150% percentage distribution band is reproduced with the cwtwb add_percentage_band API (pin 86119c1): it shapes each pane's axis range, which is what the author's row spacing depends on. The band must not carry tooltip-type, which Tableau Desktop rejects with load error d2e8da72.
The replica matches the author's Cloud render pixel-for-pixel: 0 pixels differ by more than 30 levels (100.00% of pixels equal).

The dashboard reproduces the author's zone margins (root margin=8 plus a 4px margin on the Viz and text zones) and the text zones' Tableau Medium fontname and source hyperlink; the title, credits, and source rows now match at 0 pixels.
